_meta.description: Catalogue of intent domains. Each language file (files, in this order) contributes entries to these domains; see core/README.md section 'Intents' for exact execution rules.

phone.doc: Phone actions -> {kind, slots}. Entries may be rejected by slot validation; then matching continues with the next entry.

phone_tap_open_ok.doc: 'open X' is a tap (not an app launch) only when X matches one of these.

assistant_stop.doc: Interrupt words: stop talking / stop scrolling.

assistant_risky.doc: Desktop commands from the AI that need a spoken yes first.

assistant_polite.doc: Removed from a typed/spoken turn before the command grammar.

polite_prefix.doc: Removed from the normalised command ('can you please open youtube').

polite_suffix.doc: Removed from the end of the normalised command.

polite_prefix_original.doc: Same as polite_prefix but on the original-cased text.

wake_filler.doc: Unanchored fragment: up to two filler words allowed before the wake word.

ordinal.doc: Which result: slot n (ordinal word or digits), optional slot keep (text kept in place of the match).

play.doc: Music/video request -> slot q (the search topic).

play_filler_prefix.doc: Removed from the start of a play topic.

play_suffix.doc: Removed from the end of a play topic.

play_fixes.doc: Speech-recognition fixes applied to a play topic (all matches replaced).

play_topicless_words.doc: A topic made only of these words (plus ordinal words and digits) means 'click it on screen', not a search.

play_reject.doc: A topic equal to one of these is not a play request (try the next entry).

normalize.doc: Hinglish/Hindi command -> English command (entries have replace templates).

normalize_fillers.doc: Removed from a normalised command (all matches).

question_or_creative.doc: Questions and 'write me...' requests: never typed or executed, always go to the AI.

transliteration.doc: Devanagari word -> Latin Hinglish. Longest key first, plain substring replace.

hinglish_markers.doc: Two or more of these Latin words -> the user is speaking Hinglish.

unfinished.doc: The phrase stops mid-sentence: wait for the rest.

realcount_app.doc: Time-on-app question: slot app (or app2). Entries with last_word=true use only the last word of the slot.

memory_extract.doc: Rule-based memory: every matching entry yields template.format(groups...).

memory_secret.doc: Never store text matching any of these.

memory_self.doc: Cheap pre-filter: the user is talking about themself.

meeting_action_hint.doc: No-AI meeting notes: a sentence that sounds like an action item.

meeting_decision_hint.doc: No-AI meeting notes: a sentence that records a decision.

meeting_mine.doc: An action item the user committed to (said by 'You').

task_title_prefix.doc: Removed from the start of a task title.

task_title_suffix.doc: Removed from the end of a task title.
